description: Empirical bio-crude mass-yield lookup per feedstock x temperature de-rating curve (peak at 330 C). Yields driven by lipid/protein/carb composition reused from EC147 F1b.
source: Peterson et al. (2008); Vardon et al. (2011); Elliott et al. (2015) — reused from EC147 F1b

feedstock_table.comment: Bio-crude mass yield (frac of dry ash-free feed) at optimal T, per feedstock. Lipid-rich -> higher yield.

temperature_curve.comment: Yield multiplier vs temperature (degC). Peak 1.0 at 330 C, lower at sub/super-critical extremes.
